## v3.6.2 Hotfix

### Root Cause
Saved emulator URL (10.0.2.2:8090) persisted on real devices, blocking server connection.

### Fixes
- Filter emulator-only URLs on real devices
- Multi-subnet auto-detection fallback
- Proper server readiness state management
- Reactive URL updates in login UI
